items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: David Rockefeller would say so even though he's sitting there with all the paintings.

ctx.x: Well let's leave the tragic King Lear out of this for a moment. But how do you react to this business of her saying that you disappear for years at a time? Is there some validity to that or?

Well, it's obvious why I disappear, there's no work. (LAUGHTER). She's romanticising that like they say the artists do better work when they are starving. (LAUGHTER). And the artist in the garret is up there and is supposed to be that way and David Rockefeller would say so even though he's sitting there with all the paintings.
